einzeiler: Samantha Bee joins Scott Aukerman alongside jingle entrepreneurs Craig and Ron Bieber.
kurzfassung: Scott Aukerman welcomes a special guest promoting her new show, who shares wild stories about her youth and plays a game of true or false. Later, entrepreneurs Craig and Ron Bieber drop by to discuss their unique approach to jingles and musical careers. The episode wraps up with the customary segment of character plugs.
stichpunkte: A special guest discusses her upcoming TBS show and shares memories from her time on The Daily Show.
The guest and host engage in a game of true or false, touching upon an alleged teenage career as a car thief in Toronto.
Entrepreneurs Craig and Ron Bieber join the conversation to pitch unconventional ideas and talk about their musical family.
The discussion diverges into humorous tangents about anatomical traits, childhood snacks, and custom jingles.
The episode concludes with the traditional plugs segment featuring promotional announcements.

clips.hook: I was a professional car thief.
clips.text: During a true-or-false game, the guest recalls her teenage years operating as a lookout and tool handler for automobile thefts in Canada.

clips.hook: What's the interest rate on this? 1,000% daily.
clips.text: The guests outline their aggressive financial terms for a small loan, demanding daily compounded interest.

beschreibung:
On this Bonus Bang, a very treasured special guest who shall not be named joins Scott to do some vocal exercises, play a game of “False or True?” and to talk about departing "The Daily Show" for her new TBS show "Full Frontal with Samantha Bee." Later, entrepreneurs Craig and Ron Bieber of the very famous Bieber family stop by to workshop their commercial jingles. Originally released as episode 398 on February 1, 2016.
